releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.56 — group voice calls. Calling a group from its header now opens a real call: the app creates it on the server, joins, and connects to everybody already on the line with one WebRTC connection per participant (a mesh), sharing a single microphone. The screen lists who is in the call, who is connected and who is muted, with a running timer and mute / speaker / leave. Two people offering at the same instant are resolved by the polite-peer rule instead of deadlocking, a participant who drops is shown as reconnecting, and leaving closes every connection. If the server doesn't expose the group-call routes, the app says exactly that instead of ringing into nothing. Video in group calls is the next step — this release is voice only.
